messages.subject: Re: Problem with the deSolve package
parts:
It's interesting that the package name is "deSolve", but the error message has it lowercase.
Could you double check the case of the "library(deSolve)" in the code you deployed?
I had no issue deploying the sample Shiny application with "library(deSolve)" at the top of server.R.

On Wednesday, January 24, 2018 at 5:29:25 AM UTC-5, Laura Villain wrote:
Hello,
I try to publish my first shiny app on shiny.io but I have an issue with the deSolve package.
I have put library(deSolve) on my server, but when i deploy the app there is an error message: library(desolve) : there is no package called ‘desolve’. I did the same thing with mvtnorm and ggplot2 and there is no issue.
I loaded locally the desolve package (install.packages("deSolve")) before deploying my app. And it works on my computer.

Could you please tell me why the deSolve package is not working? 

Thank you,
Regards,
Laura
